title: A Survey on Progress in LLM Alignment from the Perspective of Reward Design
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey on LLM alignment, specifically focusing on how reward models are designed to incorporate human values, ethical norms, and moral standards. It identifies 'Ethics & Values' and 'Bias & Fairness' as core 'clinical targets' in its conceptual framework for alignment, and it reviews methods for reward models to evaluate and encourage ethical behavior and moral reasoning.
